roadmap.goal: Story 6385 (S11): backend dotnet publish output moves from Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend/publish/<rid> to repo-root artifacts/publish/<rid>, so a second publish no longer nests inside the project folder and the local folder stays out of the Docker build context. Behaviour-free: the published file set per RID is identical, no production C# or TS changes. Four commits in order: pure move of the backend change rule into path-classifier.sh, widening it to .github/actions/, moving the four consumers together with un-ignoring the guard test, then .dockerignore plus the full verification procedure.

phases.name: S11: publish output outside the project folder
phases.description: Single slice, profile standard, mutation testing N/A (no production code). Commits are focused and each is green on its own. Nothing is pushed.

steps.name: Move the backend change rule into path-classifier.sh as a pure move
steps.description: Commit type: `refactor(ci): move the backend change rule into path-classifier.sh`. Read docs/ci-learnings.md (backend section) first and pre-apply its rules. Move the inline `backend` change rule from .github/workflows/ci_changes.yml into Scripts/test-selection/path-classifier.sh as BACKEND_REGEX plus classify_backend(). ci_changes.yml (which already sources path-classifier.sh) calls classify_backend; github_changes is still ORed into backend exactly as before. The regex is copied unchanged. Add a case to Scripts/test-selection/test-path-classifier.sh that pins today's behaviour (a backend path gives backend=true; .github/actions/... still gives backend=false at this point). Comments rare, written for a stranger, no internal references (no ADR, story or scenario ids). Backend tests only with --filter "TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration" (never unfiltered); in a worktree exactly 2 Licensing failures are environmental (the gitignored valid_not_expired_license.json under Lighthouse.Backend.Tests is absent) - do not chase. `dotnet build` must have 0 warnings if run. Git commands prefixed LEAN_CTX_DISABLED=1. Never push.

Backend tests only with the CLAUDE.md filter (never unfiltered); 2 Licensing failures in a worktree are environmental. Git commands prefixed LEAN_CTX_DISABLED=1. Never push.

steps.name: Publish backend output to artifacts/publish and un-ignore the guard
steps.description: Commit type: `build(publish): publish backend output to artifacts/publish instead of the project folder`. Read docs/ci-learnings.md (backend section) first. Move the four consumers from ./Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend/publish/<rid> to ./artifacts/publish/<rid> (rid: win-x64, linux-x64, osx-arm64): .github/actions/build-backend/action.yml (3 `-o` + 3 `rm -f .../appsettings.Development.json`; the trailing project argument ./Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend stays); .github/actions/package-app/action.yml (chmod -R +x path + 2 upload-artifact paths; artifact names unchanged); .github/workflows/ci_package-macos-standalone.yml (ARM64_DIR); Lighthouse.Frontend/package.json update-sidecar script (`../Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend/publish/linux-x64` -> `../artifacts/publish/linux-x64`, 3 references on one line; project argument stays). In the same commit remove `[Ignore(...)]` and the pending-reason constant from Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend.Tests/Architecture/PublishOutputOutsideProjectGuardTest.cs so the guard runs green. Do NOT touch ci_verifywindows.yml / ci_verifymacos.yml (their ./publish is unrelated), the Dockerfile's /app/publish, or Lighthouse.Frontend/build-tauri-local.sh. Optional: reword the macOS workflow comment 'Remove any stale rpath entries pointing to the old publish dir' so it states its reason without naming the old dir. Comments rare, for a stranger, no internal references (no ADR, story or scenario ids). Verify: `dotnet build` in Lighthouse.Backend with 0 warnings; backend tests only with --filter "TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration" (never unfiltered), at minimum the guard class and the architecture tests; in a worktree exactly 2 Licensing failures are environmental (gitignored valid_not_expired_license.json, copy from /storage/repos/Lighthouse/Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend.Tests/**/ if needed) - do not chase; `bash Scripts/test-selection/test-path-classifier.sh` must pass; `node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('Lighthouse.Frontend/package.json'))"` must pass; `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` in Lighthouse.Frontend must pass with zero errors and zero warnings (prebuild runs `biome check --write`: check `git status` afterwards and include a rewritten file only if it is package.json). Also run the full CLAUDE.md-filtered backend `dotnet test` (all suites); expect 0 failures (the Licensing fixture is already copied into the worktree). Git commands prefixed LEAN_CTX_DISABLED=1. Never push.
criteria: `git grep -n -i 'Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend/publish'` over .github, Lighthouse.Frontend/package.json, Dockerfile* and Scripts finds no line (the only remaining hit may be .dockerignore after step 01-04)

steps.name: Keep local publish output out of the Docker context and run the verification procedure
steps.description: Commit type: `build(docker): keep local publish output out of the build context`, then the DISTILL Verification procedure run in full, with its output recorded in docs/feature/story-6385-s11-publishdir-outside-project/feature-delta.md under `## Wave: DELIVER / [REF] Demo Evidence`, committed separately as `docs(build): demo evidence for publish output outside the project folder` AFTER the `build(docker)` commit (never in the same commit). E2E Playwright is not run in this step: the orchestrator runs it once at the final gates, which accounts for the behaviour-free guarantee. After the .dockerignore change run the full CLAUDE.md-filtered backend `dotnet test` again (all suites, 0 failures expected). Read docs/ci-learnings.md (backend section) first. Add `artifacts` and `Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend/publish` as lines to .dockerignore (each on its own line, exact text, so `grep -n '^artifacts$'` and `grep -n '^Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend/publish$'` match). Verification procedure (WORK = a scratch folder outside the repo, e.g. /tmp/claude-1000/-storage-repos-Lighthouse/fc714078-9629-4b6a-8b54-88a12a415b3e/scratchpad/): Map to the DISTILL procedure: (1) = procedure step 1; (2) = step 3; (3) = step 4; (4) = step 5; (5) = step 6; (6) = step 7; (7) docker build-context check is an ADDITION, not in the DISTILL procedure. (1) 'Before' MUST be published from the 01-02 commit (the last commit that still has the old consumer paths; the crafter resolves its hash from `LEAN_CTX_DISABLED=1 git log`) - use `LEAN_CTX_DISABLED=1 git worktree add <scratchpad>/before <01-02-commit>` and run the exact old CI command there for linux-x64, win-x64 and osx-arm64 (e.g. `dotnet publish -c Release -r <rid> --self-contained -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o ./Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend/publish/<rid> ./Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend`, then rm -f appsettings.Development.json), list name+size with the list() helper excluding the nested publish folder; 'after' is the same command with -o ./artifacts/publish/<rid> in this worktree; compare mechanically with the join/awk pass rule from the feature-delta (exit 0; every size delta listed; appsettings.Development.json absent on both sides); remove the before worktree afterwards (`LEAN_CTX_DISABLED=1 git worktree remove --force`). (2) Two publishes in a row to artifacts/publish/linux-x64: no `publish` directory inside and the second listing equals the first. (3) `find Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend -path '*/publish/*'` prints nothing in this worktree. (4) grep both .dockerignore lines. (5) `pnpm run update-sidecar` (Linux) before vs after: src-tauri/binaries and src-tauri/resources same names and sizes (the before side from the before worktree); restore any generated files afterwards so the tree stays clean. (6) Red check of the guard: put one old-path string back in a consumer file, run the guard test (it names that file:line), revert it. (7) Docker build-context check with a stale Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend/publish folder present, only if docker is available - if not, record that in the evidence and skip only that check. CI-only items (green on push, ARM64_DIR read on main) are recorded as pending the push, not run. Comments rare, for a stranger, no internal references. `dotnet build` 0 warnings; backend tests only with the CLAUDE.md filter (never unfiltered); 2 Licensing failures in a worktree are environmental. `bash Scripts/test-selection/test-path-classifier.sh` must pass. Git commands prefixed LEAN_CTX_DISABLED=1. Never push.
criteria: `grep -n '^artifacts$' .dockerignore` and `grep -n '^Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend/publish$' .dockerignore` each print exactly one matching line

For linux-x64, win-x64 and osx-arm64 the before/after comparison command exits 0: every file is on both sides and every size delta is listed and within the pass rule; appsettings.Development.json is absent on both sides
The full CLAUDE.md-filtered backend `dotnet test` (all suites) shows 0 failures after the .dockerignore change

The 'before' listing was produced from a worktree at the 01-02 commit (the last with the old consumer paths) and that worktree is removed afterwards (`LEAN_CTX_DISABLED=1 git worktree list` shows no scratchpad entry)
Two consecutive publishes to artifacts/publish/linux-x64 leave no `publish` directory inside it and the second `find` listing equals the first
`find Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend -path '*/publish/*'` prints nothing
`pnpm run update-sidecar` before and after leaves src-tauri/binaries and src-tauri/resources with identical names and sizes
With one old-path string temporarily put back, the guard test fails naming that file:line; after reverting it is green and `git status` shows that file unchanged
A docker build-context check with the stale folder present shows the folder excluded, or the evidence states docker is unavailable and only that check was skipped

feature-delta.md gains `## Wave: DELIVER / [REF] Demo Evidence` quoting the commands and their output, including the osx-arm64 folder existing at artifacts/publish/osx-arm64 and the CI-only items marked pending the push
